title: Tabulation: fill the table from the base cases up

steps.caption: Min Cost Climbing Stairs, bottom-up. dp[i] = cheapest way to STAND on step i. You may start on step 0 or 1 for free.
dp[2] = min(dp[1] + cost[1], dp[0] + cost[0]) = 10. Both inputs were filled earlier: that's the order that makes tabulation work.
dp[3] = min(dp[2] + cost[2], dp[1] + cost[1]) = 15. Both inputs were filled earlier: that's the order that makes tabulation work.
dp[4] = min(dp[3] + cost[3], dp[2] + cost[2]) = 20. Both inputs were filled earlier: that's the order that makes tabulation work.
dp[5] = min(dp[4] + cost[4], dp[3] + cost[3]) = 20. Both inputs were filled earlier: that's the order that makes tabulation work.
dp[5] = 20. Each value only needs the previous two, so two variables are enough: O(1) space.
